content.title: Web design and development services
content.answerBlock: Calwebtech designs, builds and looks after websites, online stores and web applications for B2B and growing businesses. Every build has a fixed price, runs on a platform your team can maintain, and is handed over with the code, data and accounts in your name. Most projects cost $12,000 to $60,000, and care plans start at $1,500 a month.
content.intro: Ten services, grouped by what you need: a new site or application, a particular platform, or growth and upkeep after launch.
content.empty: No services are published yet. Tell us what you need and we will reply by email.

guidance.heading: Not sure which service you need?
guidance.body: Most projects combine two or three of these. Tell us what is not working and we will say what we would do, roughly what it costs, and whether we are the right fit.

groups.name: Design & build
groups.description: Websites and web applications designed around how your buyers decide, then built so your own team can run them.

services.title: Custom website development
services.summary: Research-led design built around how your buyers actually decide, not around a template's section order.

services.title: Website redesign
services.summary: Rebuild a site that stopped working for the business, keep the rankings and pages that earn, and fix conversion, speed or a stalled project on the way.

services.title: Web application development
services.summary: Portals, dashboards, booking engines and internal tools built on Next.js with a typed API behind them.

services.title: Ecommerce development

groups.name: Platforms
groups.description: The platform follows what your team needs to maintain and what the business has to connect to, not what we prefer to sell.

services.title: Next.js development

services.title: WordPress development

services.title: Shopify development

groups.name: Growth & care

services.title: Website care plans
